items.title: 'Got no friends left': Jewish teen bullied playing Minecraft, royal commission told
items.description: The royal commission heard the 15-year-old was subjected to antisemitic slurs while playing the popular video game with students from a Perth school.

items.title: Live: Australians returning home from hantavirus cruise ship to quarantine in Perth
items.description: Australians returning home from hantavirus cruise ship will quarantine in Perth. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Health giant CSL wipes out decade of share price gains on profit warning
items.description: The ASX falls as CSL shares tank on a profit downgrade. More strong earnings news, demand for AI stocks and positive jobs data drove Wall Street higher. Follow the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Hacker deadline looms as some universities regain Canvas access
items.description: Australian universities and education departments have begun regaining access to online learning platform Canvas, after being caught up in a breach last week. However, the deadline set by the hackers continues to count down.

items.title: Breaking: Gold Coast woman Maree Mavis Crabtree cleared of son Jonathan's murder
items.description: After hearing evidence from more than 60 witnesses across five weeks, a jury retired to deliberate on Thursday afternoon and returned a verdict on Monday.

items.title: The government has missed one idea to get housing back on track
items.description: If it's serious about improving intergenerational fairness and housing affordability in this week's budget, perhaps the federal government should just build some houses.

items.title: A tropical tax paradise sells much of Australia's gas
items.description: Amid renewed debate over whether Australia is getting enough tax from its gas exports, an investigation by the ABC shows how resource giants use shell companies to shift profit.

items.title: Matt Wright back with family after what he says was 'one hell of a fight'
items.description: Outback Wrangler star Matt Wright has served five months in a Darwin prison, revealing he was not released in time for the birth of his third child.

items.title: Hundreds draw police ire after Scientology 'speed run' attempt in Brisbane
items.description: Over the weekend, Brisbane's Church of Scientology became the latest target of a viral trend that began in the United States just a few months ago — the Scientology speed run.

items.title: Media mogul Antony Catalano excused from appearing in court in person
items.description: A judge allowed the newspaper executive to appear in court via video link from his lawyer's office as he faces charges of assault, false imprisonment and making threats to kill.

items.title: Social housing demand jumps 500pc in city where baby died in riverside camp
items.description: A report by advocacy group Homelessness NSW shows demand for priority social housing has more than doubled across the state in the four years to June 2025, with a 500 per cent increase in Wagga Wagga.

items.title: A billionaire mined their land without permission. Now judgment day is looming
items.description: Tomorrow will mark a historic day for an outback WA community as the Federal Court decides how much compensation it is due after Andrew Forrest's FMG mined its land without permission.

items.title: Good behaviour bond given to NDIS worker for fraudulent claims to keep provider afloat
items.description: An Adelaide man has avoided jail for making a series of fraudulent claims with the NDIS in a bid to help the struggling business he was working for survive.

items.title: Man says drug-smuggling dad's double life led to 'nightmare' charges
items.description: A man accused of helping his father carry out a drug importation operation in Newcastle tells a jury his dad led a double life.

items.title: Indulgent breakfast recipes to enjoy at home
items.description: From shakshuka to French toast, you can enjoy an indulgent breakfast or brunch at home with one of these recipes.

items.title: 'I can't believe we did this': The joy of having babies in your 40s
items.description: Whether it's about investing in careers early, wanting to be financially stable, or waiting to meet "the right person", Australian women are increasingly having children later in life.

items.title: Why including photos in your resume is a 'red flag' and other expert tips
items.description: Here's what three experts recommend you don't put in your resume for the best chance of securing an interview or landing a role.

items.title: Lucky endangered quoll survives 600km hitchhike in Qld
items.description: Members of the public spotted the marsupial fleeing the wheel arch of a truck in Brisbane and alerted authorities.

items.title: ADFA cadet arrested, charged after hidden camera found in bathroom
items.description: An Australian Defence Force Academy cadet who allegedly used a camera hidden in a soap dispenser to film female cadets in the bathroom has been granted bail in the ACT Magistrates Court.

items.title: Appeal court overturns guilty conviction for pilot charged over fatal plane crash
items.description: Leslie Woodall had been flying three tourists from Agnes Water in central Queensland when the engine failed and the plane crashed, killing a woman.

items.title: Melbourne IT teacher jailed for stabbing school principal
items.description: The court heard IT teacher Kim Ramchen "snapped" and stabbed Keysborough Secondary College principal Aaron Sykes while children were still in class.

items.title: Queensland DNA lab clears backlog of 600 outstanding rape kits
items.description: Forensic Science Queensland was the subject of two commissions of inquiry, over failures in testing and cultural issues which may have led to miscarriages of justice.

items.title: Hasrat Gill stumbled upon the T20 World Cup on TV one day. It changed her life forever
items.description: State and WBBL cricketer Hasrat Gill has risen through the ranks of youth Australian cricket. She is one of many South Asian teenagers flocking to the sport.

items.title: Regulator found sex offender exempt from needing Working With Children Check
items.description: A sex offender serving as the president of a Melbourne charity received an exemption from requiring a Working with Children Check by Victoria's child safety regulator last year.

items.title: Ex-Parramatta Council CEO's 'Pink Ops' WhatsApp group under ICAC spotlight
items.description: ICAC is investigating allegations the former CEO of City of Parramatta Council subverted hiring practices to fill job vacancies with friends.
